personality: 3 Editorial Mobile (with strict custom color palette overrides)
personality_one_liner: Calm literary library, paper and ink, editorial warmth.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Whitespace carries the calm library personality.

dont's: Do not use blur or glass effects. Interface should feel like paper and ink.

screens.name: Home

screens.layout: Tabbed or segmented list (Inter uppercase for tabs). Clean list or grid of book covers with progress tracking.

screens.name: Quote Detail
screens.purpose: View a quote, edit it, and generate a quote card for sharing.
screens.layout: Showcase the 'Signature quote card'. Large page number, Bisque background, oversized Chambray opening quote mark. Export buttons (1080x1350 and 1080x1920) at bottom.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load fonts manually using expo-font and local assets (e.g., .ttf files), avoiding @expo-google-fonts packages as per the strict instruction.
Implement the strict color palette exactly as specified. Never use pure black. Ensure Espresso (#3A2119) is used for main text and icons. Glacier (#D2E2EC) is the default screen background.
Use ONLY Chambray (#79A3C3) as the single accent color for primary buttons, active states, and badges. Do not introduce other accent colors.

Typography is strictly Cormorant Garamond Italic (500) for titles/quotes and Inter (400/500) for UI. Use uppercase Inter with 1-3px letter-spacing (tracking) at 11-12px for metadata, page numbers, and stats.
Ensure all text is in sentence case, never Title Case.

Implement the custom bottom tab bar with 5 entries. The center 'Capture' button must be elevated, a Chambray circle, opening a modal. Tab icons must be outline 1.5px (use Feather or similarly clean outline icons), with solid fill ONLY for the active state (using Chambray).

Build the Signature Quote Card strictly: Bisque background, oversized Chambray opening quote mark, quote in Cormorant italic Espresso, source in uppercase letter-spaced Clay, divider line, 'Manent' signature + @handle, and large page number (Cormorant 500) with PAGE or CHAP. label.
Avoid heavy shadows, gradients, and neons. The design must feel flat, editorial, like paper and ink.
Use tutoiement in all French copy (e.g., 'Ton premier tableau t\'attend').
No emojis anywhere in the UI.
